name: Guest Book Cover
description:
KEY FEATURES

Celebrate your special moments with this beautifully crafted Personalized Wooden Guest Book Cover, designed to preserve memories in the most timeless and elegant way. Whether it’s a wedding, anniversary, birthday, or baby shower, this wooden cover adds a rustic charm and personal touch to any event.

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium 3mm thick wood for excellent durability and a smooth, polished finish.
    - Laser-cut with precision to create intricate patterns and decorative cutouts.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in both Horizontal and Vertical layouts to suit different preferences and page formats:
    6 × 8 inches ~ 15.24 × 20.32 cm)
    8 × 12 inches  ~ 20.32 × 30.48 cm
    - Includes a set of brass screw posts (1–1.3 cm long) for easy binding and replacing of pages.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Features high-resolution UV printing for vivid colors, sharp details, and long-lasting prints.
    - Printed on both sides: the front cover can be personalized with names, dates, or messages, while the back cover includes elegant decorative elements.

 

  • Functionality Use:
    - Ideal for weddings as a guest book, photo album, or memory journal.
    - Suitable for a variety of occasions such as birthdays, engagements, retirement parties, graduations, and more.
    - Compatible with any standard-sized paper inserts or printed sheets.
    - A stylish and sturdy alternative to traditional guest book binders.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:
    This custom guest book cover makes a meaningful and heartfelt gift for:
    - Newlyweds or couples celebrating their anniversary
    - Friends or family hosting a milestone celebration
    - Baby showers or gender reveal parties
    - Loved ones who enjoy journaling, scrapbooking, or preserving memories
    Comes ready to assemble and personalize – a unique keepsake that lasts a lifetime.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:1 xGuest Book Cover

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
